lookup_ollama_template: lookup the Ollama Modelfile template string for a given template name from OLLAMA_TEMPLATES
resolve_model_to_template: resolve a Hugging Face model ID to its Ollama template name using MODEL_TO_OLLAMA_TEMPLATE_MAPPER
list_supported_templates: list all supported Ollama template names available in OLLAMA_TEMPLATES
find_models_for_template: find all Hugging Face model IDs that map to a given Ollama template name
summarize_template_coverage: summarize which model families (llama, mistral, qwen, phi, gemma) are covered by OLLAMA_TEMPLATES
